record.bible_text: The burden<WH04853> of Moab<WH04124>. Because in the night<WH03915> Ar<WH06144> of Moab<WH04124> is laid waste<WH07703><WTH8795>, <FI>and<Fi> brought to silence<WH01820><WTH8738>; because in the night<WH03915> Kir<WH07024> of Moab<WH04124> is laid waste<WH07703><WTH8795>, <FI>and<Fi> brought to silence<WH01820><WTH8738>; <RF>brought...: or, cut off<Rf>

He is gone up<WH05927><WTH8804> to Bajith<WH01006>, and to Dibon<WH01769>, the high places<WH01116>, to weep<WH01065>: Moab<WH04124> shall howl<WH03213><WTH8686> over Nebo<WH05015>, and over Medeba<WH04311>: on all their heads<WH07218> <FI>shall be<Fi>  baldness<WH07144>, <FI>and<Fi> every beard<WH02206> cut off<WH01438><WTH8803>.

In their streets<WH02351> they shall gird<WH02296><WTH8804> themselves with sackcloth<WH08242>: on the tops<WH01406> of their houses, and in their streets<WH07339>, every one shall howl<WH03213><WTH8686>, weeping<WH01065> abundantly<WH03381><WTH8802>. <RF>weeping...: Heb. descending into weeping, or, coming down with weeping<Rf>

And Heshbon<WH02809> shall cry<WH02199><WTH8799>, and Elealeh<WH0500>: their voice<WH06963> shall be heard<WH08085><WTH8738> <FI>even<Fi> unto Jahaz<WH03096>: therefore the armed soldiers<WH02502><WTH8803> of Moab<WH04124> shall cry out<WH07321><WTH8686>; his life<WH05315> shall be grievous<WH03415><WTH8804> unto him.

My heart<WH03820> shall cry out<WH02199><WTH8799> for Moab<WH04124>; his fugitives<WH01280> <FI>shall flee<Fi> unto Zoar<WH06820>, an heifer<WH05697> of three years old<WH07992>: for by the mounting up<WH04608> of Luhith<WH03872> with weeping<WH01065> shall they go it up<WH05927><WTH8799>; for in the way<WH01870> of Horonaim<WH02773> they shall raise up<WH05782><WTH8787> a cry<WH02201> of destruction<WH07667>. <RF>his...: or, to the borders thereof, even to Zoar, as an heifer<Rf> <RF>destruction: Heb. breaking<Rf><CM>

For the waters<WH04325> of Nimrim<WH05249> shall be desolate<WH04923>: for the hay<WH02682> is withered away<WH03001><WTH8804>, the grass<WH01877> faileth<WH03615><WTH8804>, there is no green thing<WH03418>. <RF>desolate: Heb. desolations<Rf>

Therefore the abundance<WH03502> they have gotten<WH06213><WTH8804>, and that which they have laid up<WH06486>, shall they carry away<WH05375><WTH8799> to the brook<WH05158> of the willows<WH06155>. <RF>brook...: or, valley of the Arabians<Rf>

For the cry<WH02201> is gone round about<WH05362><WTH8689> the borders<WH01366> of Moab<WH04124>; the howling<WH03215> thereof unto Eglaim<WH097>, and the howling<WH03215> thereof unto Beerelim<WH0879>.

For the waters<WH04325> of Dimon<WH01775> shall be full<WH04390><WTH8804> of blood<WH01818>: for I will bring<WH07896><WTH8799> more<WH03254><WTH8737> upon Dimon<WH01775>, lions<WH0738> upon him that escapeth<WH06413> of Moab<WH04124>, and upon the remnant<WH07611> of the land<WH0127>. <RF>more: Heb. additions<Rf><CM>
